comments.body:
This demonstrates the bug:
```bash
llm openai endpoint https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/openai/ --key "$(llm keys get gemini)" -m gemini-2.5-flash --td --functions 'def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    "Get the weather for a city"
    return f"Sunny in {city}"' 'Call get_weather for Paris, London and Tokyo - make all three tool calls at once in parallel'
```
Output:
> `Error: Extra data: line 1 column 17 (char 16)`

Applying the change in this PR fixes that, thanks!
